newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products fall with crude futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products fall with crude futures.

text.p: NWE oil products were weaker on Wednesday, following falling crude futures.
Gasoline was weaker. Eurograde barges traded at $190 and $191 a tonne fob ARA but prices fell later.
Naphtha was off too, in line with futures.
Gas oil fell as benchmark July IPE gas oil futures shed $5.0. Heating oil barges were assessed at July IPE -50 cents/+50 cents fob ARA for refinery material.
High sulphur cargoes ended lower with bids sinking to $83 a tonne after earlier trades between $84 to $85. Russian cargoes were offered at two means plus $2 with buyers at up to $1.50 lower.
